rows.label: qst650206_msg0001
rows.name: Grandpa Senzou!

rows.label: qst650206_msg0002
rows.name:
I think much more highly of you now
for making something this cool, mo!

rows.label: qst650206_msg0003
rows.name: Fumo fumo fumo!

rows.label: qst650206_msg0004
rows.name:
It's not like I spent every day all
year reading books like that, mo.

rows.label: qst650206_msg0005
rows.name:
Like I said before, the romance of it
comes first for me, mo!

rows.label: qst650206_msg0006
rows.name:
Tora had you a little wrong,
Grandpa... I've got new respect for
you, mo!

rows.label: qst650206_msg0007
rows.name: Fumo fumo fumo!

rows.label: qst650206_msg0008
rows.name:
Right, so... How would we make
use of this Hanabuster, then?

rows.label: qst650206_msg0009
rows.name:
Thanks to the data you all gathered, I
can coordinate perfectly even with a
beginner Driver.

rows.label: qst650206_msg0010
rows.name:
In other words... you can use
Hanabuster as Rex's Blade or as Nia's
Blade, mo.

rows.label: qst650206_msg0011
rows.name: Can't Tora use it, mo?

rows.label: qst650206_msg0012
rows.name: You have Hana, mo.

rows.label: qst650206_msg0013
rows.name:
That's right, mo. Hana wants to fight
beside Master, mo.

rows.label: qst650206_msg0014
rows.name: Those are touching words, mo...

rows.label: qst650206_msg0015
rows.name:
As long as Tora has Hana, Hanabuster
isn't needed, mo!

rows.label: qst650206_msg0016
rows.name:
Would you like me to crush him for
you?

rows.label: qst650206_msg0017
rows.name: Mo-mo!?

rows.label: qst650206_msg0018
rows.name: I went too far, mo...

rows.label: qst650206_msg0019
rows.name:
Well, Hanabuster seems to have power
to spare, so it's about time we took
it for a test run, mo.

rows.label: qst650206_msg0020
rows.name: Understood!

rows.label: qst650206_msg0021
rows.name:
Let's try defeating a Maxim Spide in
Superbia, mo.

rows.label: qst650206_msg0022
rows.name: Perfect for a first opponent, mo.

rows.label: qst650206_msg0023
rows.name: Hana...

rows.label: qst650206_msg0024
rows.name:
It may feel unfamiliar at first to
fight while controlling Hana Mk. II,
but stay calm, mo.

rows.label: qst650206_msg0025
rows.name:
Since I am here to support the young
miss, there is no need to worry.

rows.label: qst650206_msg0026
rows.name: ...That's very reassuring, mo.

rows.label: qst650206_msg0027
rows.name:
H-her personality may be a little
difficult, but just go try it, mo!

rows.label: qst650206_msg0028
rows.name: Understood, mo!
